scope: development mechanism diagnosis; no research test or new data admission

L_exact_length.definition: original E and additive W E + b; exact-length microbatches

R_static_reference_delta.adapter_bias: unused AND frozen; zero initial; old schema may retain tensor
R_static_reference_delta.reference_gradient: no detach; same shared encoder weights
R_static_reference_delta.reference_dropout: same per-layer elementwise dropout masks as observed encoder, by replaying per-exposure torch RNG inside fork_rng. No joint concatenated 2B dropout. Resume caller CPU/CUDA RNG states on exit.
R_static_reference_delta.limitation: Removes pure static signal as a control residual; dynamic response can still depend on initial orientation through nonlinear E. This is an ablation, not full IMU design.

common.initialization: Create a single fresh original encoder/additive-adapter state after seed=20260925; clone E and W (and zero b) to both arms. Bind initial tensor hashes and implementation/env before authorization; do not resume old B0.
common.loss: Per-example mean squared normalized-x0 error over exactly 263*T valid entries; sum three example losses /3. No auxiliary losses, sample/frame weighting, or response loss.
common.optimizer_note: Retain old serialized defaults, including foreach=null and fused=null. Bind same torch/device/backend for both arms and serialize resolved settings; no independent optimizer change.
common.precision: float32; no AMP, gradient clipping, scheduler or early stopping
common.accumulation: zero_grad once per update; three true-length examples, backward(loss/3) each, then optimizer.step exactly once. Even null examples stay in denominator and MDM counts. If a null loss has no trainable graph, skip backward and record zero control-gradient contribution; do not renormalize other losses.
common.training_rng: Use training_schedule.json literally; do not redraw condition/t/noise in hooks or backbone. Equal schedule across arms; all listed examples forwarded once including null. Noise generation is PCG64 keyed by full address SHA256, not torch.randn.
common.selection: final200 only; never choose by D, losses, train or val results

input_transforms.base: Existing independently accepted 30Hz->20Hz input, train-only normalization, caption index, coordinates and root reference unchanged.
input_transforms.physical_static: At model 20Hz: a=0, O[t]=original O[0]; same mask/timestamps; normalize with old accepted train-only stats.
input_transforms.tail_reversed: At model 20Hz after interpolation: raw a and O jointly indexed [0,T-1,T-2,...,1] on all slots, then normalize; preserve frame timestamps/masks and original O[0] reference. No velocity sign flip or rotation inverse. Deliberately nonphysical sensitivity input.
input_transforms.numeric_zero: All normalized input entries zero; presence remains true. R reference still uses ORIGINAL source O[0] and normalized raw a=0. Never interpret zero rotation as valid orientation.
input_transforms.condition_off: strict presence gate; original raw backbone bypass remains available unchanged.
input_transforms.R_cache: Build observed and reference embeddings once per case in eval; subtract before adapters, then cache. No new MDM branch forwards per diffusion step.

D.mode: all modules eval; no autograd, optimizer, CFG or reverse diffusion loop
D.x_t: Use original normalized GT x0 and the frozen old backbone diffusion q_sample at indicated integer t; exactly same valid x_t across four conditions and context comparisons. Save q_sample config and effective scaled t.
D.padding: Original normalized target zero-padded to158; padded IMU/timestamps zero, encoder/loss mask false there. Concatenate SAME valid noise with addressed padding noise; q_sample entire padded tensor. Backbone mask_frames=false; do not repair it during D.
D.padded_batch: Three train sources in order 000027,000506,004728 at fixed config,t,noise seed,condition; 32 batch forwards x3=96 branch examples. Length158 member is batch-shape numerical control, not padding-treatment case.
D.exact_batch: 384 batch-size1 forwards, one MDM branch each. Text always present; text_only is f10, other conditions f11. No four-way CFG.
D.instrumentation: Read hooks in those same forwards; no extra model calls to obtain hidden/reference tensors. Cache/reuse exact static probes for E(u)-E(static).
D.stop: A deterministic implementation/identity/nonfinite error stops entire queue before training. Poor finite diagnostic metrics do NOT adapt or stop arms.

software_tolerances.purpose: Numerical identity checks only, not quality/effect thresholds; log all actual max/RMS values.
software_tolerances.input_acceleration: exact equality to accepted reference; orientation/normalized_imu atol=2e-7 rtol=0
software_tolerances.static_residual_forward: identical input/reference with shared dropout: encoded difference and injected residual exactly zero (float32); adapter bias never reintroduced
software_tolerances.static_gradient: CPU fixture max absolute encoder/adapter gradient <=1e-7 for static loss contribution before optimizer/weight-decay; retain continuous max and finite counts

null_and_R_static_x0.description: same-device matched single step; target is exact equality; tolerance accommodates operation ordering only

full_sample_null_or_R_static.description: continuous decoded max plus bitwise status; do not align. Exceedance is implementation/replay discrepancy, not model-quality failure.

accumulated_gradient_CPU.description: explicit sum of per-example objectives vs microbatch accumulation, same frozen RNG; optimizer steps exactly200; no tolerating count mismatch

required_outputs.D: Each of480 slots: IDs/context/t/noise-address and actual x_t hashes, normalized predicted x0 float32, target/hash/mask, encoder pre-temporal + each2 layer + final output, each8 pre-add motion hidden and gated residual on valid frames, and scalar counts/sums_sq/RMS/max. Loss/probe reductions independently replayable by02. Identical tensors may be stored once by SHA256 with references; never add forwards to obtain hooks.
required_outputs.training: Common initial state hashes and immutable initialization artifact;600 per-exposure IDs/t/noise/condition/encoder-dropout addresses, shape/loss and200 step receipts per arm;actual optimizer/env/code/input/protocol hashes;selected final200 and periodic50/100/150 checkpoints;R reference construction and counters. No unplanned checkpoint selection.
required_outputs.samples: Original full motion + normalized263 + GT + input/raw/normalized/reference tensors + original frame0 source/hash + masks/times + condition flags + random plan, now also arm/split/final checkpoint/mode/package hashes. Preserve all120 planned statuses including failures/not-run. Float32/eval/condition_cache=true, no AMP.
required_outputs.runtime: One complete queue ledger, stage deadlines, reserved/attempted/completed counters, actual encoder calls,all receipts/errors and artifact hashes; preserve partially completed stages without promoting partial model to final.

execution: 01 implements and CPU validates; 02 independently accepts; then obtain new explicit authorization bound to package, final code, run directory, GPU UUID; preflight precedes single execution. This package is not an executable authorization.
